stories.title: Urbagestión plantea al Ayuntamiento de Madrid una propuesta para que Maricarmen, desahuciada ayer, vuelva a su vivienda

en.title: Urbagestión proposes to Madrid City Council a plan for Maricarmen, evicted yesterday, to return to her home
en.summary: Urbagestión has presented a proposal to Madrid City Council for an evicted woman to return to her home. The company has offered its support to the Municipal Housing and Land Company and municipal social services.

stories.title: La pareja del arquitecto Josep Juanpere, en libertad provisional tras pagar una fianza de 80.000 euros

en.title: Josep Juanpere's partner released on provisional freedom after paying a bail of 80,000 euros
en.summary: The partner of architect Josep Juanpere has been released on provisional freedom after paying a bail of 80,000 euros. The woman is under investigation for the alleged homicide of the architect in 2025 and denies the charges.

stories.title: En libertad la pareja de Josep Juanpere, investigada por su homicidio, tras abonar la fianza de 80.000 euros

en.title: Josep Juanpere's partner released after paying the 80,000 euros bail, under investigation for his homicide
en.summary: Belén López, partner of architect Josep Juanpere, has been released after paying an 80,000 euro bail. Juanpere died in December at age 72 at his second home in Baqueira, and after nine months of investigation by Mossos d'Esquadra, she was arrested on homicide charges.

stories.title: La novia del arquitecto Josep Juanpere, acusada de homicidio, evita la cárcel al hacer efectivo el pago de 80.000 euros de fianza

en.title: Josep Juanpere's girlfriend, accused of homicide, avoids jail by paying 80,000 euros bail
en.summary: The partner of architect Josep Juanpere, arrested the previous Wednesday in Madrid, avoided jail by paying an 80,000 euro bail. The Vielha court ordered her imprisonment conditional on posting bail.

stories.title: Volkswagen llama a revisión a casi tres millones de coches de dos de sus marcas por riesgo de corrosión

en.title: Volkswagen recalls nearly three million cars from two of its brands due to corrosion risk
en.summary: Volkswagen is recalling over 2.8 million VW and Audi vehicles worldwide because of steering bolt corrosion that could cause steering failure. The recall affects 2.16 million VW models and 700,000 Audi vehicles, with about one-third located in Germany.

stories.title: Volkswagen y Audi retiran casi tres millones de vehículos en todo el mundo por un fallo técnico

en.title: Volkswagen and Audi withdraw nearly three million vehicles worldwide due to technical fault
en.summary: Volkswagen and Audi are withdrawing nearly three million vehicles globally that require adjustments due to potential steering system problems.

stories.title: Urbagestión asegura que ha propuesto un plan al Ayuntamiento de Madrid para que Maricarmen vuelva a su casa

en.title: Urbagestión assures that it has proposed a plan to Madrid City Council for Maricarmen to return home
en.summary: Property management company Urbagestión stated it has submitted a proposal to Madrid's municipal government and that the property is not for sale but available for finding a housing solution.

stories.title: Cazas de Finlandia y Suecia interceptan un escuadrón de aviones rusos en el Báltico

en.title: Fighter jets from Finland and Sweden intercept a squadron of Russian planes in the Baltic
en.summary: Finnish and Swedish fighter jets intercepted a Russian patrol formation in the Baltic region consisting of a Tu-134 transport aircraft and an unspecified number of MiG-31 and Su-30 fighter jets.

stories.title: Cazas de Finlandia y Suecia interceptan aviones de combate rusos en el Báltico

en.title: Finnish and Swedish fighter jets intercept Russian combat aircraft in the Baltic
en.summary: Russian military aircraft flew over the Baltic Sea on Thursday, prompting NATO forces to deploy fighter jets from Sweden and Finland to monitor the situation. The Russian aircraft included a Tu-134 transport plane and several MiG-31 and Su-30 fighters.

stories.title: Volkswagen y Audi llaman a revisión a casi tres millones de vehículos en todo el mundo por un fallo técnico

en.title: Volkswagen and Audi recall nearly three million vehicles worldwide due to technical defect
en.summary: Volkswagen and Audi are calling for recalls of nearly three million vehicles globally due to potential steering system faults requiring technical adjustments.

stories.title: Volkswagen y Audi llaman a revisión 2,8 millones de coches por un fallo técnico

en.title: Volkswagen and Audi recall 2.8 million cars due to technical defect
en.summary: Volkswagen and Audi identified corrosion problems in bolts affecting key models produced between 2013 and 2024, though vehicles can continue operating safely until serviced.

stories.title: La pareja del arquitecto Josep Juanpere queda en libertad tras abonar la fianza de 80.000 euros

en.title: Partner of architect Josep Juanpere released on bail of 80,000 euros
en.summary: The partner of architect Josep Juanpere was released from custody after posting a bail of 80,000 euros set by the judge.

stories.title: Volkswagen, Audi y Seat llaman a revisión casi tres millones de coches por un posible fallo de dirección

en.title: Volkswagen, Audi and Seat recall nearly three million cars due to possible steering fault
en.summary: Volkswagen, Audi, and Seat are recalling approximately three million vehicles across multiple model series due to potential corrosion issues in a steering system fastener screw discovered during internal quality inspections.

stories.title: El Ibex reconquista los 19.700 puntos y gana un 1% en la semana

en.title: Ibex recaptures 19,700 points and gains 1% in the week
en.summary: The Spanish stock index rebounded following Iran's proposed truce with the United States and a decline in oil prices, reversing earlier losses and achieving weekly gains.

stories.title: Grupo Lar asciende a Miguel Ángel Peña como nuevo CEO

en.title: Grupo Lar promotes Miguel Ángel Peña as new CEO
en.summary: Grupo Lar appointed Miguel Ángel Peña as chief executive officer, marking the first time an executive outside the shareholder base has held this position.

stories.title: Díaz hace campaña para presidir la OIT en Nueva York: "Debe ser imparcial, pero nunca neutral"

en.title: Díaz campaigns to lead the ILO in New York: "It must be impartial, but never neutral"
en.summary: Spain's first vice president campaigned for leadership of the International Labour Organization, calling for stronger action on equality and human rights in supply chains.

stories.title: El Ibex 35 ante la recta final del año: ¿qué valores tienen más potencial?

en.title: The Ibex 35 in the final stretch of the year: which stocks have the most potential?
en.summary: The Ibex 35 is trading at record highs, but analysts believe there is still room for further gains.
